Acceptance_Criteria: Every assembly labelled with project revision assembly ID and unique serial number
No undocumented deviation
Every connector matches controlled index and cannot be confused with adjacent same-family connector where harmful
100 percent cavity-to-circuit match against released cavity schedule
Every intended circuit continuous with no intermittent result during gentle flex test
No circuit shorted to adjacent circuits power ground shield or chassis unless specified
No unintended B+ or switched-power short to ground before connection to electronics
CAN H/L twisted continuously except minimum breakout length and polarity correct
Only released termination points present; service connector does not introduce unintended permanent termination
CKP/shield routing follows released segregation and shield termination strategy
Sensor/reference and high-current grounds follow released splice/ground reference
Approved sealed/motorsport splice method; no unapproved solder joints
Correct terminal/wire range insulation support conductor brush and retention; sample pull test where applicable
All populated cavities sealed correctly and unused cavities fitted with specified plugs where required
No exposed conductor; transitions sealed; no sharp edge or excessive compression
No conductor load transferred directly to terminal during normal service movement
Turbo/exhaust proximity branches have released heat protection and clearance provisions
As-built dimensions recorded and within agreed manufacturing tolerance
Labels readable durable and match released IDs
Relay sub-harness dry contact grounds A21 only when commanded and never applies +12 V to A21
Removal of O11 command or relay power opens A21 request circuit
X71/OEM pigtail arrangement retains sealing retention and full steering movement without strain
Every PMU output branch maps to released O-number and load connector
Every FT550 cavity used maps to released function and connector
Installed harness matches released direct-drive or Peak-and-Hold build state
Any insulation test method/voltage is approved and sensitive electronics are disconnected
No damage contamination loose terminals exposed braid or unfinished branch
Build record test report as-built dimensions photos BOM and deviations supplied
HAT-001 through applicable HAT-028 PASS and engineering approves deviations
